text: {"requester":{"id":"op-1147","cls":"operator"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_batch7","campaign_class":"composition_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before swap"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0457"},"comment":"routine swap to fresh FTO-glass plate"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-0457","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard init"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCo baseline film, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":900,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard crystallization step per SOP-OER-3 (routine)"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.5,"y":8.0},"comment":"locate deposited spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"chronopotentiometry at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"model":"gp_overpotential","data_ref":"latest"},"comment":"update GP surrogate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"1 h stability check"}]}
